data.title: DNA Translation
data.statement:
mRNA sequences code for proteins. In an mRNA sequence, three nucleotides (three letters in the sequence) combine for one amino acid (one element in the protein sequence). mRNA begins coding the protein at the start codon, {{AUG}}, and ends at a stop codon, {{UAG}}, {{UAA}}, or {{UGA}}, without skipping any codons in between.

Output the protein sequence if there is one. If no protein sequence exists, output {{NONE}}. If the sequence exists but does not terminate properly, it is abnormal, so output {{ELIMINATE}}.

```
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

|  F \ S   |         U          |         C          |         A          |         G          |
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

|          |  UUU, UUC -> Phe   |  UCU, UCC -> Ser   |  UAU, UAC -> Tyr   |  UGU, UGC -> Cys   |
|    U     |  UUA, UUG -> Leu   |  UCA, UCG -> Ser   |  UAA, UAG -> STOP  |  UGA -> STOP       |
|          |                    |                    |                    |  UGG -> Trp        |
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

|          |  CUU, CUC -> Leu   |  CCU, CCC -> Pro   |  CAU, CAC -> His   |  CGU, CGC -> Arg   |
|    C     |  CUA, CUG -> Leu   |  CCA, CCG -> Pro   |  CAA, CAG -> Gln   |  CGA, CGG -> Arg   |
|          |                    |                    |                    |                    |
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

|          |  AUU, AUC -> Ile   |  ACU, ACC -> Thr   |  AAU, AAC -> Asn   |  AGU, AGC -> Ser   |
|    A     |  AUA -> Ile        |  ACA, ACG -> Thr   |  AAA, AAG -> Lys   |  AGA, AGG -> Arg   |
|          |  AUG -> Met        |                    |                    |                    |
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

|          |  GUU, GUC -> Val   |  GCU, GCC -> Ala   |  GAU, GAC -> Asp   |  GGU, GGC -> Gly   |
|    G     |  GUA, GUG -> Val   |  GCA, GCG -> Ala   |  GAA, GAG -> Glu   |  GGA, GGG -> Gly   |
|          |                    |                    |                    |                    |
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+
```

An example of using this table for the codon {{AUG}}:
- {{AUG}} starts with <<A >> so move down to the 3rd row
- {{AUG}}'s second letter is <<U>>, so move to the 1st column
- You should see <<AUG->Met>> which means {{AUG}} codes for <<Met>>

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

mRNA sequences code for proteins. In an mRNA sequence, three nucleotides (three letters in the sequence) combine for one amino acid (one element in the protein sequence). mRNA begins coding the protein at the start codon, AUG, and ends at a stop codon, UAG, UAA, or UGA, without skipping any codons in between.

Output the protein sequence if there is one. If no protein sequence exists, output NONE. If the sequence exists but does not terminate properly, it is abnormal, so output ELIMINATE.


+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

|  F \ S   |         U          |         C          |         A          |         G          |
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

|          |  UUU, UUC -> Phe   |  UCU, UCC -> Ser   |  UAU, UAC -> Tyr   |  UGU, UGC -> Cys   |
|    U     |  UUA, UUG -> Leu   |  UCA, UCG -> Ser   |  UAA, UAG -> STOP  |  UGA -> STOP       |
|          |                    |                    |                    |  UGG -> Trp        |
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

|          |  CUU, CUC -> Leu   |  CCU, CCC -> Pro   |  CAU, CAC -> His   |  CGU, CGC -> Arg   |
|    C     |  CUA, CUG -> Leu   |  CCA, CCG -> Pro   |  CAA, CAG -> Gln   |  CGA, CGG -> Arg   |
|          |                    |                    |                    |                    |
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

|          |  AUU, AUC -> Ile   |  ACU, ACC -> Thr   |  AAU, AAC -> Asn   |  AGU, AGC -> Ser   |
|    A     |  AUA -> Ile        |  ACA, ACG -> Thr   |  AAA, AAG -> Lys   |  AGA, AGG -> Arg   |
|          |  AUG -> Met        |                    |                    |                    |
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+

|          |  GUU, GUC -> Val   |  GCU, GCC -> Ala   |  GAU, GAC -> Asp   |  GGU, GGC -> Gly   |
|    G     |  GUA, GUG -> Val   |  GCA, GCG -> Ala   |  GAA, GAG -> Glu   |  GGA, GGG -> Gly   |
|          |                    |                    |                    |                    |
+----------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+--------------------+


An example of using this table for the codon AUG:
- AUG starts with A  so move down to the 3rd row
- AUG's second letter is U, so move to the 1st column
- You should see <<AUG->Met>> which means AUG codes for Met




   

      
Input

      
Line 1: A string h that includes all 64 codon combinations and what they code for separated by spaces formatted, codon:amino acid.
Line 2: A string s of nucleotides (individual letters) with a 5' Cap (m7Gppp) and a Poly-A Tail (AAAA...)

   

   

      
Output

      
Line 1: The protein sequence with each amino acid (each element) separated by a space, from Met to STOP. If there is no sequence, output NONE. If the sequence is abnormal and has no stop codon, output ELIMINATE.

   

   

      
Constraints

      
length of Line 1 = 514
0 < length of s < 1000

   

   

      
Example

      

         

            
Input

            
UUU:Phe UUC:Phe UUA:Leu UUG:Leu UCU:Ser UCC:Ser UCA:Ser UCG:Ser UAU:Tyr UAC:Tyr UAA:STOP UAG:STOP UGU:Cys UGC:Cys UGA:STOP UGG:Trp CUU:Leu CUC:Leu CUA:Leu CUG:Leu CCU:Pro CCC:Pro CCA:Pro CCG:Pro CAU:His CAC:His CAA:Gln CAG:Gln CGU:Arg CGC:Arg CGA:Arg CGG:Arg AUU:Ile AUC:Ile AUA:Ile AUG:Met ACU:Thr ACC:Thr ACA:Thr ACG:Thr AAU:Asn AAC:Asn AAA:Lys AAG:Lys AGU:Ser AGC:Ser AGA:Arg AGG:Arg GUU:Val GUC:Val GUA:Val GUG:Val GCU:Ala GCC:Ala GCA:Ala GCG:Ala GAU:Asp GAC:Asp GAA:Glu GAG:Glu GGU:Gly GGC:Gly GGA:Gly GGG:Gly
m7GpppGGCAUAAUGUUUGCACUGAAAGGGUAUCCCGUAUAACCGAUCAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

         

         

            
Output

            
Met Phe Ala Leu Lys Gly Tyr Pro Val STOP
